audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Royal justice, poor and needy people, empire-scale language, tribute, abundance, and peace.

verses.restored: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness to the king’s son.

familiar.text: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king’s son.

notes.title: Royal justice
notes.body: The psalm evaluates royal power by justice for poor and oppressed people. It does not grant sacred immunity to rulers.

modern.text: Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.

original.text: לִשְׁלֹמֹ֨ה אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ תֵּ֑ן וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ לְבֶן מֶֽלֶךְ

verses.restored: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

familiar.text: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

modern.text: May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.

original.text: יָדִ֣ין עַמְּךָ֣ בְצֶ֑דֶק וַעֲנִיֶּ֥יךָ בְמִשְׁפָּֽט

verses.restored: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

familiar.text: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

modern.text: May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.

original.text: יִשְׂא֤וּ הָרִ֓ים שָׁ֘ל֥וֹם לָעָ֑ם וּ֝גְבָע֗וֹת בִּצְדָקָֽה

verses.restored: May he judge the poor of the people, save the children of the needy, and crush the oppressor.

familiar.text: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

modern.text: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.

original.text: יִשְׁפֹּ֤ט עֲֽנִיֵּי עָ֗ם י֭וֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶבְי֑וֹן וִֽידַכֵּ֣א עוֹשֵֽׁק

verses.restored: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

familiar.text: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

modern.text: May they fear him as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains, through all generations.

original.text: יִֽירָא֥וּךָ עִם שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵ֥י יָ֝רֵ֗חַ דּ֣וֹר דּוֹרִֽים

verses.restored: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

familiar.text: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

modern.text: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.

original.text: יֵ֭רֵד כְּמָטָ֣ר עַל גֵּ֑ז כִּ֝רְבִיבִ֗ים זַרְזִ֥יף אָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

familiar.text: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

modern.text: May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound, until the moon is no more.

original.text: יִֽפְרַח בְּיָמָ֥יו צַדִּ֑יק וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַד בְּלִ֥י יָרֵֽחַ

verses.restored: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the earth.

familiar.text: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

notes.title: Sea to sea
notes.body: Universal royal language is ancient court poetry. It must not become a mandate for empire, colonialism, conquest, or modern territorial domination.

modern.text: May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.

original.text: וְ֭יֵרְדְּ מִיָּ֣ם עַד יָ֑ם וּ֝מִנָּהָ֗ר עַד אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

familiar.text: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

modern.text: May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.

original.text: לְ֭פָנָיו יִכְרְע֣וּ צִיִּ֑ים וְ֝אֹיְבָ֗יו עָפָ֥ר יְלַחֵֽכוּ

verses.restored: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

familiar.text: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

modern.text: May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.

original.text: מַלְכֵ֬י תַרְשִׁ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִיִּים מִנְחָ֣ה יָשִׁ֑יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י שְׁבָ֥א וּ֝סְבָ֗א אֶשְׁכָּ֥ר יַקְרִֽיבוּ

verses.restored: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

familiar.text: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

modern.text: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.

original.text: וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ ל֥וֹ כָל מְלָכִ֑ים כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם יַֽעַבְדֽוּהוּ

verses.restored: For he delivers the needy who cries out, the poor also, and the one who has no helper.

familiar.text: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.

modern.text: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.

original.text: כִּֽי יַ֭צִּיל אֶבְי֣וֹן מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝עָנִ֗י וְֽאֵין עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ

verses.restored: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

familiar.text: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

modern.text: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.

original.text: יָ֭חֹס עַל דַּ֣ל וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יוֹשִֽׁיעַ

verses.restored: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

familiar.text: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

modern.text: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.

original.text: מִתּ֣וֹךְ וּ֭מֵחָמָס יִגְאַ֣ל נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְיֵיקַ֖ר דָּמָ֣ם בְּעֵינָֽיו

verses.restored: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

familiar.text: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

modern.text: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.

original.text: וִיחִ֗י וְיִתֶּן לוֹ֮ מִזְּהַ֪ב שְׁ֫בָ֥א וְיִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעֲד֣וֹ תָמִ֑יד כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם יְבָרֲכֶֽנְהֽוּ

verses.restored: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

familiar.text: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

modern.text: May there be an abundance of grain in the land; may it sway atop the hills. May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon, and its people like the grass of the field.

original.text: יְהִ֤י פִסַּת בַּ֨ר בָּאָרֶץ֮ בְּרֹ֪אשׁ הָ֫רִ֥ים יִרְעַ֣שׁ כַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן פִּרְי֑וֹ וְיָצִ֥יצוּ מֵ֝עִ֗יר כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

familiar.text: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

modern.text: May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.

original.text: יְהִ֤י שְׁמ֨וֹ לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם לִפְנֵי שֶׁמֶשׁ֮ ינין שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ וְיִתְבָּ֥רְכוּ ב֑וֹ כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם יְאַשְּׁרֽוּהוּ

verses.restored: Blessed be YHWH God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

familiar.text: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

modern.text: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

original.text: בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֹשֵׂ֖ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת לְבַדּֽוֹ

verses.restored: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

familiar.text: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

modern.text: And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.

original.text: וּבָר֤וּךְ שֵׁ֥ם כְּבוֹד֗וֹ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם וְיִמָּלֵ֣א כְ֭בוֹדוֹ אֶת כֹּ֥ל הָאָ֗רֶץ אָ֘מֵ֥ן וְאָמֵֽן

verses.restored: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

familiar.text: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

modern.text: Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.

original.text: כָּלּ֥וּ תְפִלּ֑וֹת דָּ֝וִ֗ד בֶּן יִשָֽׁי

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Kingship is judged by protection of vulnerable people; universal rule language cannot justify colonialism, theocracy, or leader immunity.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
